summary: Tests-only (red-phase) run for issue #39. Committed: byte-identical upstream parity corpus fixture + SolverParityCorpusTests (scorer- and solver-level replay of all 12 scenarios: exact scores, earliest-index-wins selections incl. 2-way/3-way/duplicate ties, missing-measurement exclusions, zero-weight and unknown-key weight handling); reconstructed OpenAPI 3 document for the /api/v1 palette read surface (color_matching@47057afd, spec from viamin/color_matching#110) + OpenAPIContractTests schema-to-DTO drift detector + PaletteAPIClientContractTests migration regression net (requests, bearer header, error mapping, envelopes, spec-declared routes); docs for corpus refresh and migration findings. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed by any means; bin/lint --staged ran and exited 0 by design ('Swift toolchain not available; skipping build and tests'). Expected outcomes were cross-verified with an equivalent offline replay of the same algorithm over the corpus: 12/12 scenarios agree exactly (scores, selections, tie sets, exclusions). Generated-client implementation (swift-openapi-generator plugin, Package.swift) is deferred to the implementation run per test-phase boundaries; README.md is outside the test-phase allowlist, so its corpus section is staged verbatim in docs/solver-parity-corpus.md.
